files.purpose: Pure m:ss formatter for the match timer
Thin MonoBehaviour that shows CombatMatch.ElapsedSeconds in the timer label
Timer layout: full-screen click-through root with one label

integration_notes: Create a UI GameObject (e.g. prefab Assets/Prefabs/UI/MatchTimer) in the Match scene with UIDocument (source asset Assets/UI/MatchTimer.uxml, PanelSettings RuralRumblePanelSettings) and MatchTimerView.
Give it a sort order above or equal to the MatchHud document; the root ignores picking so it never blocks input.
Keep default script execution order (0) so Start runs after MatchBootstrap.
assumptions: Style tag USS selectors use classes; the root fills the screen via absolute positioning.
MatchTimerView relies on CombatMatch.ElapsedSeconds being a float property (as used in MatchBootstrap).
If the shared PanelSettings theme lacks the default font, bold uses the theme's default font.
